## Tabla resumen: fórmulas clave de la clase

<div class="mt-20">
<table class="fragment fade-in" data-fragment-index="1" style="font-size: 22px; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse;">
<tr style="background:#a78bfa; color:white;">
<th class="pad-8">Concepto</th>
<th class="pad-8">Fórmula</th>
<th class="pad-8">Condición</th>
</tr>
<tr style="background:#f3f4f6;">
<td class="pad-8">Probabilidad condicional</td>
<td class="pad-8">$P(A|B) = \frac{P(A \cap B)}{P(B)}$</td>
<td class="pad-8">$P(B)>0$</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="pad-8">Regla de multiplicación</td>
<td class="pad-8">$P(A \cap B) = P(A|B)P(B)$</td>
<td class="pad-8">,</td>
</tr>
<tr style="background:#f3f4f6;">
<td class="pad-8">Independencia</td>
<td class="pad-8">$P(A \cap B) = P(A)P(B)$</td>
<td class="pad-8">,</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="pad-8">Prob. total</td>
<td class="pad-8">$P(A) = \sum_i P(A|B_i)P(B_i)$</td>
<td class="pad-8">$\{B_i\}$ partición</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
